text.p: NeXstar Pharmaceuticals Inc and Liposome Co Inc said Monday they had reached a settlement related to all of their outstanding patent litigation.

Under the terms of the settlement, all current U.S. and international litigation proceedings between Liposome and NeXstar will be dismissed, and Liposome has granted NeXstar immunity from suit in connection with the worldwide production and sales of AmBisome, NeXstar liposomal formulation of amphotericin B.
In addition, the companies said they have granted each other options to take licenses under other patented technology.
As part of the settlement, NeXstar has agrees to make certain payments to Liposome; the amounts of those payments were not disclosed.
Other terms of the settlement were not disclosed by the companies.
Fujisawa USA Inc, which licenses the U.S. and Canadian marketing and distribution rights to AmBisome, is also a party to the settlement.
